subject: [hw] DONE V11
body:
V11 (A32 media / saturating arithmetic / divide) is done, host-tested only. No phone, nothing published, nothing committed (worker rules).

Test command and last lines:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh
    gen_enc.py: 172 encodings
    N2TEST V11 PASS 954/954
    N2TEST V11 PASS 954/954
(twice: -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, then plain -O2; both -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; ~18 s; builds only under /tmp/n2hw-V11.)

What is implemented (n2a32_arm_media only, per include/n2a32.h; never branches, never touches memory, never prints):
SXTB SXTH UXTB UXTH SXTAB SXTAH UXTAB UXTAH SXTB16 SXTAB16 UXTB16 UXTAB16 (ROR #0/8/16/24);
UBFX SBFX BFI BFC; REV REV16 REVSH RBIT; SSAT USAT SSAT16 USAT16; PKHBT PKHTB SEL;
36 parallel add/sub (S,Q,SH,U,UQ,UH x ADD16 ASX SAX SUB16 ADD8 SUB8) with GE only for S/U;
QADD QSUB QDADD QDSUB; SMULxy SMLAxy SMULWy SMLAWy SMLALxy SMUAD(X) SMUSD(X) SMLAD(X) SMLSD(X)
SMLALD(X) SMLSLD(X) SMMUL(R) SMMLA(R) SMMLS(R); USAD8 USADA8; SDIV UDIV (div by 0 = 0,
INT_MIN/-1 = INT_MIN). 954 checks per build: 172 llvm-mc encodings x >=6 literal cases, flag/
saturation/GE/Q/overflow edges, SP operands, 52 must-be-UNDEF encodings, 200000-word sweep of
the class space under ASan/UBSan.

Correction found during the final audit and fixed (important for anyone deriving the class):
the X subtract forms must be product1 - product2 with product1 = Rn.lo*Rm.hi and
product2 = Rn.hi*Rm.lo (SMUSDX/SMLSDX/SMLSLDX), not the reverse. Evidence: Arm A32/T32 reference
"subtracts the second product from the first" and the __smusdx intrinsic doc (p1 = val1[15:0] *
val2[31:16], p2 = val1[31:16] * val2[15:0]). My first revision had it the other way round and the
test literals had been derived from the same wrong reading, so they passed; both are corrected
now, plus a new SMLSDX overflow/Q case. End-to-end through V02s core: smusdx r0,r1,r2 with
r1=0x00030002, r2=0x00050004 now returns 0xfffffffe (2*5 - 3*4 = -2). V15s T32 code already had
the right order.

Acceptance:
1. N2TEST PASS above.
2. Census (D01): zero A32 instructions reachable in all five vendor objects (309511 instructions,
   all Thumb), so no mnemonic of this class used by the vendor libraries is returned UNDEF; the
   check holds vacuously. Recorded in emu/test_v11/STATUS.md section 7.
3. Differential harness: T01 installed the kernels as tests/emu/kernels/k07_v11_media.c; with the
   current core all k_v11_* kernels pass in arm-O0/arm-O2/arm-O3v/armv8-O3v with 0 mismatches
   (arm-O0: 1860 pass / 0 mismatch / 240 stop, all k_f* VFP). The harness overall still FAILs
   from the thumb columns, where every k_v11_* stop is a T32 BL (V16) or the V15 PKH bug; the
   failure list attributes those kernels to V11, but no V11 instruction is involved.

Not done / open (all in STATUS):
- No arm64 iOS compile check (nothing platform-specific) and no phone run (no device code).
- The dual-multiply family, the 8/16-bit parallel families and SEL are not reachable from the C
  differential kernels: clang lowers the idioms to SMULxy/SMLABB/and+orr, not SMUSD/SADD16/SEL.
  Those forms are covered by unit tests with llvm-mc encodings and literals only.
- A few UNPREDICTABLE-but-allocated forms execute with a defined effect instead of UNDEF
  (SMULxy/SMULWy with a non-zero fixed field); no valid encoding is affected.
- USAT #0 = saturate to 0 follows the UnsignedSat wording [I].
- Not committed; files are untracked for the lead/main session.

Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_media.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/t_v11.c,
gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/STATUS.md, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V11/STATUS.md. The other
test_v11 files (run_tests.sh, gen_enc.py, v11_enc.s, k_v11_media.c) are unchanged from the first
revision. Staying available for review findings.
